node.title: Re^4: Need script help
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [kcott],

I assume what the AM is talking about is that scripts you write on your machine can omit [doc://warnings], [doc://strict] and [doc://autodie], and if you copy that script to another machine - or even run it as another user - those pragmas will not be in effect there, altering the behavior of your scripts.

Also, scripts you copy onto your machine are now suddenly running with [doc://autodie], which will also change their behavior.

Regards,
-- Hauke D
